titulo: Making it to the end of the month
intro: Money at home and in the country: prices, taxes, loans and the sectors of an economy.
p.la crisis.nota: The singular and plural have the same form: la crisis, las crisis.
p.el paro.nota: Used for unemployment especially in Spain; el desempleo is general.
p.pedir un préstamo: to apply for / take out a loan
p.disminuir.nota: Adds y before a/e/o: disminuye, disminuyen.
b1.texto:
At home: **ganar** un sueldo, **pagar impuestos**, **pedir un préstamo**, **pagar intereses**, **deber dinero**, **tener ahorros**. If the money is not enough, **no llegas a fin de mes**.

In the country: **la economía crece** or **está en crisis**; **los precios suben** or **bajan**; **el paro aumenta** or **disminuye**.

The sectors: **la agricultura**, **la ganadería** and **la pesca**; **la industria** and **la construcción**; **el comercio**, **el turismo** and the rest of **el sector servicios**.

A country **exporta** what it sells abroad and **importa** what it buys.

To describe a trend: **cada vez más** / **menos**; **está subiendo**; **ha bajado un** cinco **por ciento**.

Nouns from adjectives: pobre → **la pobreza**; rico → **la riqueza**.
b2.f0: For centuries this region lived off agriculture, livestock and fishing.
b2.f1: Today most people work in the service sector, above all in tourism.
b2.f2: Industry exports oil and wine, but the region imports almost all its energy.
b2.f3: With the crisis prices went up and unemployment among young people increased.
b2.f4: Many families had to take out loans and they find it harder and harder to make ends meet.
b2.f5: Companies offer training so that their employees improve their skills.
b4.o1: I won't arrive at the end of the month.
b4.o1.explicacion: The idiom is about money running out.
b4.o2.explicacion: The idiom is about money running out.
b5.pregunta: A country sells its wine abroad. It…
b5.o1.refuerzo: Importar is to buy from abroad.
b6.pregunta: Complete: prices have gone up five per cent.
b6.o0.refuerzo: A change of a certain percentage: un cinco por ciento.
b6.o1.refuerzo: The amount of change takes un.
b6.o2.refuerzo: The amount of change takes un.
b7.pregunta: According to the text, where do most people work today?
b7.o0.refuerzo: En el sector servicios, sobre todo en el turismo.
b8.pregunta: Complete: …so that their employees improve their skills.
b8.o0.refuerzo: Para que takes the subjunctive: mejoren.
b8.o2.refuerzo: Para que needs a conjugated verb, so mejoren, not the infinitive mejorar.
b9.traduccion: They find it harder and harder to make ends meet.
b10.texto:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (100–120 words).** Write about the economic situation of your country or region: work, prices and prospects.

**Speak (about 2 minutes).** Explain aloud how the cost of living has changed in your town in recent years.
b4.o0.explicacion: No llego a fin de mes means I don't have enough money to last the month.
